summary: The document outlines components and controls for generating reports related to student expense claims. It includes validators, labels, buttons, and calendar extenders. There is functionality for generating reports in Excel format and displaying report data in HTML.
purpose: To provide a user control interface for generating and viewing reports of student expense claims.

workflows.name: Generate Report
steps: User inputs start and end dates.
User clicks on the Excel button ('cmdExcel_Click').
Parameters are set with session ID and date range.
Output is formatted as CSV and displayed in the HTML panel.

business_rules: The report generation relies on a valid session ID.
Date fields must be validated for correct formats.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end dates.
system_behavior: JavaScript setup for date fields' client IDs.
Display of report HTML if generated content is available.
dependencies: Relies on HSPnet database procedures and session management.
